blocks.html: Upselling is a sales strategy that encourages customers to purchase a higher-tier, upgraded, or premium version of a product or service to increase overall transaction value.

Upselling helps businesses grow revenue from existing buying intent by presenting options with added features, better performance, or greater value. When done correctly, it benefits both the customer and the business.
The goal is to show customers a better-fit option rather than simply pushing a more expensive purchase.
Boosts revenue without new customer acquisition
Enhances customer satisfaction with better-fit solutions
A software provider offers a prospect an upgraded plan with advanced reporting and automation features instead of the basic package.
Upselling is a revenue growth strategy that encourages customers to choose higher-value options that better meet their needs.
Increase revenue from every opportunity. MarketJoy helps businesses build upselling strategies that improve conversions and customer value.
